# Vajra Precast Industry

> Leading precast concrete manufacturer in Bihar, India. Vajra Precast Industry manufactures heavy-duty interlocking paver blocks, tactile tiles for the visually impaired, chequered anti-skid tiles, high-density fly ash bricks, and custom precast infrastructure components using 53-grade cement, high-frequency vibration compaction, and genuine Tata T-130 synthetic iron oxide pigments.

Vajra Precast Industry operates an automated precast manufacturing facility located at Fatehpur, Sampatchak, Patna-Gaya Road, Bihar. The plant functions 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year with on-site staff for instant loading, dispatch, quality inspection, and government/private procurement.

## Manufacturing Standards & Technical Specifications
- **Compaction Technology**: High-Frequency Mold & Table Vibration Compaction (50+ Hz) eliminating air voids and maximizing aggregate density.
- **Curing Protocol**: Continuous Water Incubation Curing in automated factory tanks, guaranteeing complete chemical hydration crystallization without thermal micro-cracks.
- **Cement Grade**: 53-Grade Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) for early high strength and durability.
- **Color Pigmentation**: Genuine Tata Pigments (Grade T-130 Synthetic Red Iron Oxide) providing UV-stable, non-fading, weather-resistant pigmentation.
- **Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Adherence**: IS 15658:2006 (Concrete Pavers), IS 1077 (Building Bricks), IS 456 (Plain and Reinforced Concrete).
- **Quality Control**: Strict pre-dispatch compressive testing, water absorption testing, and dimensional tolerance checks.

## Product Catalog & Engineering Specifications

### 1. Heavy-Duty Uni-Paver (I-Shape / Dumbbell) Blocks
- [Uni-Paver Specifications](https://vajraprecast.com/#catalog): Lateral interlocking precast blocks for maximum shear resistance under heavy wheel loads.
- **Compressive Strength**: M40 - M50 Grade (45 to 55 MPa).
- **Standard Thickness**: 60mm (medium traffic / commercial) and 80mm (heavy industrial / container yards).
- **Applications**: Petrol pumps, industrial yards, logistics parks, highway toll plazas, heavy transport corridors.
- **Available Colors**: Terracotta Red (Tata T-130) and Industrial Slate Grey.

### 2. Tri-Hex (3-Hexagon Cluster) Pavers
- [Tri-Hex Pavers](https://vajraprecast.com/#catalog): Architectural tri-hexagonal cluster blocks with multi-directional interlocking facets.
- **Compressive Strength**: M40 - M45 Grade (40 to 45 MPa).
- **Standard Thickness**: 60mm and 80mm.
- **Applications**: Premium township roads, hotel driveways, municipal plazas, commercial frontage.

### 3. Tactile Blister Warning Tiles (Accessibility for the Visually Impaired)
- [Tactile Warning Tiles](https://vajraprecast.com/#catalog): Specially designed hazard warning tiles featuring a 6x6 matrix of 36 raised truncated domes (blisters) to guide visually impaired citizens safely.
- **Compliance**: Follows CPWD, Indian Railways, and international accessibility standards.
- **Compressive Strength**: M35 - M40 Grade (35 to 40 MPa).
- **Standard Thickness**: 30mm and 40mm.
- **Applications**: Metro railway stations, airport terminals, railway platforms, bus terminals, pedestrian sidewalk ramps, public building entrances.
- **Color**: High-contrast safety yellow and terracotta red for optical low-vision awareness.

### 4. Octagon & Square Interlocking Tiles
- [Octagon & Square Pavers](https://vajraprecast.com/#catalog): Dual-geometry interlocking paving system with alternating octagons and locking dot squares.
- **Compressive Strength**: M35 - M40 Grade (35 to 40 MPa).
- **Standard Thickness**: 40mm and 60mm.
- **Applications**: Residential pathways, parking bays, recreational gardens, resort walkways.

### 5. Chequered Anti-Skid Floor Tiles
- [Chequered Floor Tiles](https://vajraprecast.com/#catalog): Heavy textured grooved tile surfaces providing anti-slip pedestrian safety even during monsoon conditions.
- **Compressive Strength**: M30 - M35 Grade (30 to 35 MPa).
- **Standard Thickness**: 25mm and 30mm.
- **Applications**: Covered parking, commercial basement walkways, ramps, exterior corridors, terrace flooring.

### 6. High-Density Fly Ash Bricks
- [Fly Ash Bricks](https://vajraprecast.com/#catalog): Uniform modular building bricks manufactured from industrial fly ash, cement, and quarry sand.
- **Class / Strength**: Class 10 to Class 15 (100 to 150 kg/cm²).
- **Features**: Razor-sharp edges, uniform dimensions reducing mortar consumption by 25%, superior thermal insulation, zero efflorescence.
- **Applications**: Multi-story building masonry, boundary structures, institutional infrastructure.

### 7. Precast RCC Boundary Walls & Prestressed Columns
- [Precast Boundary Walls](https://vajraprecast.com/#catalog): Factory-cured reinforced concrete panels and slotted columns for quick, cost-effective perimeter security.
- **Features**: Fast installation (up to 300 feet per day), termite-proof, weatherproof, reusable and relocatable.
- **Applications**: Industrial park perimeter, farmland fencing, highway enclosures, residential boundaries.

### 8. Custom Concrete Engineering (Design as per Demand)
- [Custom On-Demand Manufacturing](https://vajraprecast.com/#custom): 100% flexible custom mold fabrication for architectural, municipal, and private project requirements.
- **Customization Options**: Any geometric shape or logo embossment, any Tata T-130 pigment shade, any thickness (25mm to 100mm+), and any required compressive strength (M30 to M60+).
